'''Carl Mike Hardy Hunt Down And Destroy The Happy Fun Ball''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Hunt Down And Destroy The Happy Fun Ball'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it on 6 September 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 6 September 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4|Premiere-L-yavin4.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Happy Fun Ball
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Y4 Hardy LS 2000 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

I've selected the starting stuff which will be the typical start all the time. Deploy the Yavin 4: Jungle and one of the Docking Bays on your first turn, if possible. Then deploy someone to the docking bay to secure the Staging Areas Force generation. By the third or fourth turn you should have plenty of Force to deploy what you need to, to flip. Once you do flip, Daughter of Skywalker and Boshek will be your attack run candidates. Use Luke and Obi with sticks to secure your Yavin sites or nail any Dark Side straglers, plus they can help defeat Imperial Decree. With your high ability and the Rebel Techs on Yavin, blowing away the DS should be a snap. With the Death Star gone, you have some fighting capability with the Organized Attacks and Out Of Nowhere. I'll Take The Leader, will ensure your logevity in space. Have fun with it, and enjoy!
